findings: TransformerLens offers real model-internal interventions via HookPoint forward/backward hooks whose returned values can replace intermediate activations.
Path-patching/caching machinery is directly relevant to causal tests of a local J-Space/GWT vector on a compatible transformer.
Qwen2ForCausalLM has explicit audited weight conversion support; exact Qwen3-class target compatibility was not established and remains UNKNOWN.
The package has a broad dependency/runtime surface, so direct full import is not justified by E1 evidence alone.
Best current reuse is a thin causal-intervention donor pattern plus E2 comparison against pyvene and minimal native PyTorch hooks.
falsifier_value: A controlled activation injection plus lesion/rescue on the exact local target can distinguish causal model-state uptake from textual/logging correlation, but only if checkpoint/tokenizer/event/generation/vector identities are bound end-to-end.
recommended_next_gate: E2 comparative design: TransformerLens vs pyvene vs minimal PyTorch hooks on exact ~0.8B target compatibility, identity/provenance, reversible intervention, overhead and fail-closed behavior.
